exposure: local (intragestational sac) and intramuscular (IM) methotrexate (MTX) injections
cohort: 18 women with either Cesarean scar pregnancy (n = 16) or cervical pregnancy (n = 2)
finding: Ultrasound-guided placement and inflation of Foley balloon catheters was found to be a safe and effective method for preventing or managing bleeding complications in women undergoing treatment for CSP or CxP.
